notesI18n.zh: 安装时自动补齐 Node、Git、Claude Code、Codex 与依赖，镜像竞速与失败换源，运行验证通过后完成安装。 修复自动生成未知访问密码的问题：安全密码改为主动启用，未启用时本机直接使用，无登录或退出；提供旧版凭据恢复。安装及运行时检测缺失 Git 后自动安装并验证，完成后继续原操作。
notesI18n.en: Automatically install Node, Git, Claude Code, Codex and dependencies during setup, with mirror selection, fallback and executable verification. Remove hidden generated workspace passwords: security passwords are opt-in, local use requires no sign-in, and legacy credentials can be recovered locally. Missing Git installs automatically during setup and runtime, verifies successfully, and resumes the pending action.
